name: Ash-Lad
description: The youngest son, mocked for idleness, who keeps pace with the colts, discovers their enchantment, and answers the king’s riddle truthfully in a clever way.
visualPrompt: A lean young farm boy with tousled dark hair and soot-smudged clothes, alert eyes and a determined expression, wearing simple forest-traveling garments and sturdy boots, holding himself with quiet confidence

name: The King
description: A stern ruler who wagers his daughter and half his kingdom against a brutal punishment to test those who herd his seven colts.
visualPrompt: A middle-aged king with a severe face and heavy brow, dressed in rich yet austere robes with a fur-trimmed cloak, standing rigidly as if judging an oath

name: The Spinning Hag
description: A deceitful old woman in the mountain cleft who lures the first two brothers into laziness and tries to stop Ash-Lad.
visualPrompt: A hunched old hag with wispy grey hair and sharp, watchful eyes, wrapped in worn shawls, seated in a rocky cleft with a distaff and spindle, her hands busy and her mouth set in a sly grin

name: The Youngest Colt (Enchanted Prince)
description: The speaking colt who aids Ash-Lad, leads him to the hidden stump-door and church, and reveals how to break the spell on the seven brothers.
visualPrompt: A sleek dark colt with intelligent eyes and a proud stance, subtle hints of nobility in its bearing, mane ruffled by wind as it moves with uncanny purpose through the forest

name: The Princess
description: The king’s daughter, promised as the prize for the successful herdsman and sister to the seven enchanted princes.
visualPrompt: A young princess with fair hair and a composed, gentle expression, dressed in a simple yet elegant gown fit for a wedding feast, with a quiet strength in her posture
